title: Guadalajara Surprise, Laver Cup Line‑up & WTA Finals Move – What African Punters Need to Know
flags: BBC Tennis reported that **Marta Kostyuk** is through to the last eight of the **Guadalajara Open** despite not having played a single point. The top seed withdrew, handing Kostyuk a free pass.

Dimers.com released a seven‑pick slate for Thursday, highlighting the **Olga Blinkova vs. Alena Valdmannova** clash. While the article doesn’t give exact odds, it signals that bookmakers see this as a **tight contest** with potential for upset.

The Sporting News (via Yahoo Sports) broke down the **star‑studded Laver Cup line‑up** set to battle in London. With **Carlos Alcaraz**, **Alexander Zverev**, **Ben Shelton** and other big names, the event promises high‑profile match‑ups that attract both casual fans and seasoned bettors.
BBC Tennis announced that **Charlotte, USA** will stage the **WTA Finals** for three years starting in 2027.

Yahoo Sports listed the **2026 Grand Slam champions** – **Jannik Sinner**, **Carlos Alcaraz**, **Elena Rybakina** – while BBC Tennis reminded us it’s been 23 years since an American won a men’s Grand Slam.
BBC Tennis reported that former world No. 4 **Jack Draper** will not play again this season, planning a return next year.
